summary: Production launch mode is explicitly invite/comp-only until real provider contract, monitoring, cost controls, and staging verification are connected. Provider routing keeps production generation behind invite-only access and records comp-only production mode evidence without claiming public paid generation.

provider_contract.provider_routing_policy: production provider routing denies public paid real generation and permits only invite/comp-only cohorts
provider_contract.monitoring: production monitoring records comp-only provider route usage and denies public paid provider activation
provider_contract.cost: production cost exposure is capped at zero billable public paid provider usage while comp-only mode is active
provider_contract.staging_verification: real provider staging verification remains a prerequisite before switching from comp-only to paid public launch

coverage.runtime_probe: Production provider routing replay selected invite/comp-only mode for allowed invite cohorts and denied public paid real generation routes.
coverage.deployment_evidence: ops/evidence/production/provider-mode.json records production provider mode, comp-only production mode, provider routing policy, monitoring, cost, and staging verification prerequisites.

coverage.runtime_probe: Production real provider activation remains disabled for public paid launch until real provider contract, monitoring, cost controls, and staging verification are present.
coverage.deployment_evidence: The production provider mode evidence keeps real provider status not_enabled_for_public_paid_launch while proving explicit invite/comp-only mode.
